university-of-west-florida.academicEntry: Freshmen submit secondary records and credential evaluation. SAT, ACT or CLT admission-score rules apply; the page links Regulations 3.001 and 3.042. An English-test table for 60+ transfer credits is not a freshman admission route.

university-of-west-florida.remaining: Exact current admission-test section thresholds, any freshman IELTS-only exception and Fall 2027-specific revision remain to be established.

le-moyne-college.academicEntry: First-year checklist: application, essay, one academic recommendation and official secondary transcript. SAT/ACT are explicitly optional on the current undergraduate application page. The international page puts IELTS 6.5 under graduate admission, so it is not copied to this bachelor route.
le-moyne-college.scope: International first-year bachelor; programme/qualification exceptions remain explicit; an undated active page does not by itself confirm Fall 2027.
le-moyne-college.remaining: A current international undergraduate English-proof checklist, numerical minima, section rules and waiver conditions are still needed; graduate IELTS 6.5 is not evidence.

university-of-the-pacific.academicEntry: Secondary completion and all school/college transcripts are required. Admissions Test Scores says SAT/ACT optional, including direct-admit international applicants; the active academic catalogue still says freshmen must submit them. Neither source establishes which rule governs Fall 2027.
university-of-the-pacific.scope: International first-year bachelor; programme/qualification exceptions remain explicit; an undated active page does not by itself confirm Fall 2027.
university-of-the-pacific.remaining: Admission must resolve the conflict between the catalogue and the Test Scores page for the selected programme/intake; no confirmed SAT waiver is used.

stockton-university.academicEntry: Secondary completion, translated records and qualification evaluation are required. Admissions permits test-optional outside Accelerated Medical, Pharmacy and Nursing. Global Engagement additionally requires SAT/ACT for applicants from English-speaking educational countries. The overlapping applicant scope remains contradictory.
stockton-university.scope: International first-year bachelor; programme/qualification exceptions remain explicit; an undated active page does not by itself confirm Fall 2027.
stockton-university.remaining: Admissions must clarify the English-speaking-applicant requirement versus test-optional and the exact chosen specialty. The undated pages do not explicitly confirm Fall 2027.

saint-marys-college-indiana.academicEntry: International applicants submit translated detailed secondary records, a recommendation, essay and financial certification. The catalogue specifically allows non-native English speakers to submit TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo instead of SAT; its general testing paragraph retains an international-test exception. A separate mandatory SAT is not inferred for applicants using the named language-test alternative.
saint-marys-college-indiana.scope: International first-year bachelor; programme/qualification exceptions remain explicit; an undated active page does not by itself confirm Fall 2027.
saint-marys-college-indiana.remaining: The exact applicant language category, programme and selected-cycle requirements must be confirmed; catalogue and international-page score guidance are not universal admission cutoffs.

john-jay-college.academicEntry: International freshmen submit secondary transcripts, graduation diplomas and official English translations directly to CUNY; this checklist says external evaluations are not required. It strongly recommends SAT/ACT for non-English-country applicants or those without school Math/English; a recommendation is not a mandatory test rule.
john-jay-college.scope: International first-year bachelor; programme/qualification exceptions remain explicit; an undated active page does not by itself confirm Fall 2027.
john-jay-college.remaining: The exact Fall 2027 CUNY-wide score-consideration policy and programme-specific exceptions need the current CUNY applicant guide.

milwaukee-school-of-engineering.academicEntry: Official secondary records are required. Pre-calculus or higher, Physics and Chemistry form the recommended preparation; 3.2 cumulative GPA is recommended, not an automatic eligibility guarantee. SAT/ACT are optional initially, but available scores may be requested after academic review.
milwaukee-school-of-engineering.scope: International first-year bachelor; programme/qualification exceptions remain explicit; an undated active page does not by itself confirm Fall 2027.
milwaukee-school-of-engineering.remaining: Exact programme prerequisites, any individual request for scores and the named Fall 2027 cycle remain applicant-specific.

manhattan-university.academicEntry: First-year applicants submit an official secondary transcript, recommendation and essay. SAT/ACT are explicitly optional; academic record and chosen-programme preparation remain part of holistic review. English-proof alternatives on the international page are a separate requirement.
manhattan-university.scope: International first-year bachelor; programme/qualification exceptions remain explicit; an undated active page does not by itself confirm Fall 2027.
